content: उदन् ^1¦ €2 <ab>P.</ab> (उद्-अन्) To breathe upwards, send out the breath in an upward direction (<ab>opp.</ab> अपान्); य उदानेन उदानिति स आत्मा सर्वान्तरः <ls>Bṛ. Up. 3. 4. 1</ls>.

उदन् ^2¦ {%n.%} [उन्द्-कनिन् <ls>P. VI. 1. 63</ls>] Water (usually occurring in compounds either at the beginning or at the end, and as an optional substitute for उदक after the <ab>acc.</ab> dual. It has no forms for the first five inflections. In <ab>comp.</ab> it drops its न्); {%<ab>e. g.</ab>%} उदधि, अच्छोद, क्षीरोद <ab>&c.</ab>
